open_questions: API Group and chemistry (2026-10 audit): both Tier 1 values were attributed to sources for a different product, aramcoULTRA 8, and are now Missing. Former API Group: 'Group III' (Reported), cited to the Aramco base-oil catalog 2024 p.25, which is the aramcoULTRA slate table for grades 4/6/8 and does not list P-20 or any Premium-series grade; former note: 'Group III explicitly confirmed for aramcoULTRA 8 in Aramco's official 2024 base-oil catalog. The original 2018 SDS did not state the API Group.' Former chemistry: 'Distillates (petroleum), hydrotreated heavy paraffinic' (Reported; printed text 'Distillates (petroleum), hydrotreated heavy paraffinic; CAS 64742-54-7; purity 100%'), cited to DL2-14611.pdf p.1, the SDS for 'Base Oil aramcoULTRA 8 (250 Neutral)' revised 2018-09-07. Former open question: 'API Group III confirmed for aramcoULTRA 8 using Aramco's official 2024 base-oil catalog; classification was not explicitly stated in the original 2018 SDS.' No reviewed document states the API Group or chemistry of P-20; the Premium Series sheet DL2-11173.pdf names neither. Confirm both with S-OIL.
S-OIL's official Premium Series catalog reports specific gravity 0.8520 at 15/4°C (ASTM D1298), but absolute density remains unverified.
No grade-specific CCS viscosity or test temperature was verified for P-20.
Grade-specific SDS and additional technical documentation require reconciliation.
